name: GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra
summary: Run everyday coding and agent work on Sol, which nearly matches Astra on coding at about a fifth of the cost ($2/$10 per million tokens). Live now in Codex, ChatGPT Plus and Pro, and the API, with Astra 20% cheaper.

name: MAI Code 2 Flash
summary: Get quick explanations, targeted edits, and routine fixes from a new coding model that's included even on the free GitHub Copilot plan. Pick it in VS Code, Copilot CLI, Xcode, JetBrains, or github.com.

name: Gemini Notebook interactive sites
summary: Type "make me a site" and turn your notes and sources into a shareable interactive page, like a dashboard, project tracker, or visual explainer. Rolling out globally on the web now, with mobile coming soon.

name: llama.cpp 1.0
summary: Run open models like Kimi K3.1 Pro on your own machine, now with a stable 1.0 API, a redesigned local chat UI, and an OpenAI-compatible text-to-speech endpoint. Free and open source.

name: Gemini 4 Hydrogen
summary: Run everyday coding and agent tasks on a fast, cheaper Gemini with a 1M-token context at $1.50/$7.50 per million tokens. Available now in Google AI Studio, the Gemini API, Android Studio, and the Gemini app.

name: Atlas
summary: Turn one photo, or up to 64, into an explorable 3D world, then block out and restyle sets with simple shapes. Viewfinder, Chisel, and the developer API are now open to everyone in the browser.

name: H3-Image
summary: Generate or edit 4K product shots and mockups in under 10 seconds, guided by up to 16 reference images. Open weights are on Hugging Face under a community license, or use it cheaply through the MiniMax API and Hailuo AI.

name: Claude Sheets
summary: Describe a budget, tracker, or client list and get a working multi-tab workbook with formulas, formatting, and dropdowns, then keep editing it alongside Claude. In beta on paid Claude plans across web, desktop, and mobile.
